focus: Class 7 expands every subject outward: integers grow into rational numbers and simple equations, Science moves from observation to explanation with heat, acids and motion, and Social Science opens a thousand years of history. Students benefit most from reading ahead, asking why at every step, and keeping short self-made notes from this year on.

faqs.question: How is Class 7 different from Class 6?
faqs.answer: Explanations replace descriptions — Science chapters ask for mechanisms (how heat flows, why acids behave so) and Mathematics introduces formal equation solving. Reading the chapter before class helps enormously.

faqs.question: Which Class 7 chapters matter later?
faqs.answer: Integers and rational numbers, simple equations, and lines and angles are direct prerequisites for Class 8 algebra and geometry.
